title: DAMAGE NUMBERS CLEAR THE TARGET NAME
why: The critic on the g-84 LMG pictures found growing numbers covering the target name and other hit colours. Draw each above the nameplate with an 8 unit gap and separate simultaneous numbers horizontally. Red numbers rise 48 units clear of the head and reticle. Watch: read a mixed weak point and body burst, two players hitting one enemy, and your red number near the reticle; colours and totals should remain distinct.
now: Growing damage numbers sit above target names and separate when their text would overlap. Red hurt numbers sit clear of your head. Totals, colours and hit timing are unchanged.
